# SIG — build ledger (orchestrate-build machine state; committed build memory v2, ADR-073)

> **OPERATING MODE — Round 11** (SEED-17; binds rows 201–510 from GATE-B). Full text, sources, operator's words: `docs/build/reports/OPERATING_MODE_R11.md`; per-ticket subset: manifest `## Operating rules`. Supersedes Round-1's mode, the R10 import amendment and SEED-10's placeholder (archived).
>
> - **State.** Round 11 in progress (GATE-B, C10 2026-10-01); prior State/head lines archived byte-for-byte (comment above). PHASE LOG ends: P34.43 (PR #255), P34.49 (PR #256), P34.44a (PR #257 — quality registry + ratchet); next → P34.44b (row 256).
> - **Dispatch (round 25).** One `swe-2-high` orchestrator session (`orchestrate-build`), a fresh sub-agent per ticket. A `returnPass` key is a landed ticket, never re-dispatched: its leg runs as its re-run line says. Isolation check (plan §8.5) at the T6 probe, P34.1, each sub-round GATE and every restart; on failure: pause, then a T6-verified `drive-build.sh --agent-cmd` (round 27), else `--print-prompt` + new session.
> - **Orient (≤ 48 KiB).** O1 this head · O3 `### RETURN PASS — current` · O4 `current_projection.py verify` + `docs/build/reports/current/CURRENT.md` · O5 the last 3 lines · O6 next row's manifest line + contract header. Never LEDGER, DEFERRALS or BUILD_INDEX whole. Re-measure each Load at dispatch (bytes ÷ 3, ÷ 4 + ≈17.5k skill-text share): ≤ ~150k loaded, else split.
> - **Clock (OM-04).** Every date from `date -u` at writing or a named git/GitHub time. A scheduled-event read-back (D-P31.4-1, batch-05 OSM replay) waits for `date -u` ≥ its fire time and `lastAttemptTime`.
> - **CI (OM-05; H2).** Before each dispatch `ci-boundary.sh --ledger docs/build/LEDGER.md --ticket <lastCompleted> --stack` (five required jobs): red, pending or unknown → `blockedOn`; nothing stacks on red. Record `git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main <chainTip>` at each boundary.
> - **Records (OM-13).** Protected regions only gain lines, at their ends: `check-build-memory.sh . --staged` before each closeout commit, `--range <tip before>..<tip after>` at each boundary. Corrections are appended (ADR-146); `db/sqitch.plan` L44–52 are never re-stamped (C-10). Closeouts: the README "rows 1-N as of" line; VERDICTS for a new verdict word; `FLIPPED <date> (<gate|ADR>)`; `DONE <date> (evidence) — was: OPEN …`; transitions need evidence.
> - **Harness (OM-01, A-21).** `harness:` and each contract and run-ledger `Harness:` = devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent. The operator stays commit author ("Keep my name"); every agent commit carries a harness trailer, checked in CI. Another harness or model → stop and ask.
> - **Pauses (A-15, A-2b).** Only at HG gates (HG-03 lines, HG-11 / Class S readouts), one ING-GO per wave, spend above $300/mo, red CI, a production mutation not on a live OM-20 list, the gate markers, a usage-limit event (stop, digest, ask). OM-18: stop and ask. Silence is never consent.
> - **Digest (A-2).** `digest.sh --ledger docs/build/LEDGER.md --trigger <why> --write --spend "<infra vs $300 + source>" --usage "<agent usage | not measured>"` per wave, pause, session end, usage-limit event.
> - **Pre-authorisation (OM-20).** Only live GATE DECISIONS `pre-authorization` rows: the 13 11A rows (expires: GATE-G4; P34.40 = L1+L2 incl. `/v1/*` (GB-Q4); P34.6 = drill clone only) and the B-9 Class R standing go (renewed only at a sub-round GATE). OM-20's class list is never pre-authorised.
> - **Gates (plan §8.3).** S5-2 packets (`continue` answers batch lines only); no GATE while an OM-19 leg is due; GATE-ANNOUNCE waits on REVIEW-R11's S0/S1 dispositions (fix rows re-anchor it: rows after 510, a new GATE-ANNOUNCE row, `superseded-by(row <n>)` on 510). HG-03 flips: agent patch on `r11/<wave>-flips`, applied in an operator-signed commit or row (OP-26).
> - **Live legs (OM-19, AR-1…AR-9).** A leg outside its window or go queues in RETURN PASS; due legs run at each boundary on `r11/<id>-live-<n>`; backstop prompt `docs/build/planning/2026-09-30-next-phase/stageB/LEG_RUNNER_PROMPT.md` (OP-24). AR-2 restore point first; AR-3 windows.
> - **Live API (A-20).** Structural spine writes may change live API answers before HG-11 only with the basis label + a `/status/` notice, and still need an OM-20 listing or in-ticket go.
> - **Contact (P16, C-8, U-011).** Alias first: no request needing a contact string before the contact@ alias; no outside contact; no agent claims a human check (B-31, B-42).
> - **Numbers.** Ticket-authored ADRs: next free number ≥ ADR-191 at dispatch; copy batches: `docs/build/reports/copy-batches/batch-<NN>.md`; re-run `later_register.py` on planning-data change.
> - **Skills.** No B6 §5.3 override in force (only if T6 finds Devin Desktop does not load `~/.claude/skills`).
